name: Post-Purchase
goal: Turn every order into a well-installed project and a second order: set honest expectations, help them prep and install, ask for a review once it's up, then suggest the pieces that finish the job.
trigger: Placed Order (Klaviyo metric trigger from the Miva integration). Trigger filter: is_samples_only = false, so samples-only orders go to Sample-to-Order instead.
flow_filters: Order is not samples-only (is_samples_only = false). Samples-only orders enter Sample-to-Order.
Placed Order (non-sample) zero times since starting this flow. A newer order ends this run and starts a fresh one in the repeat branch, so nobody gets two parallel sequences.
Country is not Canada OR email consent is subscribed (CASL). US buyers who never subscribed can receive these under CAN-SPAM.
SMS steps only: can receive SMS marketing (consented).
exit_conditions: Places another non-sample order: this run ends and the new order starts a new run (repeat branch).
Order cancelled or fully refunded, if Miva sends a Cancelled Order or Refunded Order event.
Unsubscribes from email (email steps) or texts STOP (SMS steps).
smart_sending: E1 variants (PP-E1, PP-E1R, PP-E1M): Smart Sending OFF, because they are order-specific and should always arrive. All other emails ON (16h). SMS ON (24h), quiet hours 10am-8pm local, max 3 marketing texts per rolling 7 days.

branches.label: First order, in-stock only
branches.rule: Placed Order where is_samples_only = false equals 1 time over all time (this order) AND has_made_to_order = false

branches.label: Repeat order, in-stock only
branches.rule: Placed Order where is_samples_only = false at least 2 times over all time AND has_made_to_order = false

branches.label: Contains made-to-order
branches.rule: has_made_to_order = true (any order count). Gets PP-E1M, and E3, S2 and E4 wait until the order has shipped.

kpis.target: 6% (starting benchmark; reset after 60 days of data)

kpis.metric: Review page clicks per recipient (E3 + S2)
Repeat order rate within 90 days of entry

build_notes: Data: the Placed Order event must carry line items with SKU, product name, category, image URL, product URL and a made_to_order flag, plus order-level booleans is_samples_only and has_made_to_order. If Miva has no made_to_order flag, derive it from category/SKU: vinyl shutters, wood shutters, Design Your Own builder items (BUILDER-COR, BUILDER-BKT, BUILDER-FLT, BM) and made-to-order faux wood beams.

Structure: Trigger > conditional split on has_made_to_order. YES = M path (PP-E1M). NO = second split on non-sample order count >= 2: YES = R path (PP-E1R), NO = F path (PP-E1). Klaviyo branches do not rejoin, so clone the tail (S1, E2, E3, S2, E4) into each path with identical content. Each customer receives 4 emails and up to 2 texts; the file holds 6 emails because E1 has three variants.
PP-E1M is shared by first and repeat made-to-order orders, so its copy works for both. Optional: add a show/hide line 'Good to see you again.' for repeat customers.

M path timing: E3, S2 and E4 must not ask for a review or push add-ons before a made-to-order piece has even shipped. Preferred build: if Miva sends a shipment event (Fulfilled Order / Shipped), end the M path after E2 and run its E3, S2 and E4 from a small clone flow triggered on that event with has_made_to_order = true (E3 10 days after shipment, S2 1 day later, E4 7 days after E3). Fallback: set the M-path delay before E3 to the confirmed {{ MTO_LEAD_TIME }} plus 14 days.
Do not duplicate the storefront's transactional order and shipping confirmations. No order totals, tracking numbers or addresses in these emails; refer to the confirmations instead.
PP-S1 link: defaults to /HELP.html. If the Placed Order event carries product URLs, link the first line item's product page instead, since that is where its installation guide and specs live.

PP-E2 category tips block: one short tip per purchased category, written from the Ekena installation guides and approved by customer service before launch. Safe starters: Beams - find the joists and confirm the mounting method in the guide before marking beam lines. Shutters - measure every window; follow the guide's fastening method for your siding. Corbels and brackets - check the specs before anything rests on them. Mantels - follow the guide and your local code for clearances around the fireplace. Columns - confirm in the specs whether the column is decorative or structural. Moulding and trim - plan corners and joints and dry-fit first. Ceiling medallions - turn off power at the breaker before working around a light fixture. No invented specs, cure times or load ratings.

PP-E3 and PP-S2 review link: the store reviews page (/architecturaldepot-customer-reviews.html). If a product-review app is connected later, swap to its per-product review form. Do not gate reviews: everyone gets the same ask, happy or not.

PP-S2 condition: skip anyone who clicked the review link in PP-E3 (Clicked Email where URL contains 'customer-reviews' since starting flow). If the review platform sends a Submitted Review event, use that instead.
PP-E3: if {{ INSTAGRAM_HANDLE }} is not confirmed at launch, delete the sentence that mentions it rather than shipping the token.

PP-E4 cross-sell map (products block): corbels > shelf brackets, mantels; beams > beam straps, brackets, corbels; shutters > SteelTek shutter hardware; mantels > corbels, moulding; columns > balustrade railing kits; moulding and trim > ceiling medallions. Exclude items already purchased; prefer the same material line and finish. Fallback when nothing maps: Ekena Millwork catalog picks.
PP-E4 alt version: once depot_dollars_balance and depot_dollars_expiration_date sync from Miva, switch to the balance version in alt_versions.
{{ category_name }} in PP-E4 subject_b uses the first line item's category with a fallback of 'project' (Klaviyo default filter).

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, thank you for your first order with Architectural Depot. You'll get separate order and shipping confirmations with your tracking details. This note covers the rest: what to expect, what you earned and how to make delivery day go smoothly.

items.title: You earn Depot Dollars

items.title: Inspect it on arrival

hero.headline: Get ready while it's on the way
hero.subhead: A little prep now makes install day go smoother, whether your order is in transit or still being built.
hero.image: Prep scene: tape measure, pencil, level and stud finder beside an open installation guide on a work surface, a boxed Ekena piece in soft focus behind. No branded tools.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, whether you're installing it yourself or handing it to a contractor, a little prep now saves time later. Every product page has the installation guide and specs for that piece. Start there, because the guide for your exact product beats any general advice.

items.title: Read the guide first
items.text: Note the recommended fasteners, adhesive and finishing steps.

items.title: Re-check your measurements
items.text: Measure the wall, ceiling or opening again and mark where each piece goes.

items.title: Know what's behind the surface
items.text: Find the studs, joists or solid backing and check the wall or ceiling structure before you mount anything.

items.title: Gather what the guide calls for
items.text: Have the recommended fasteners, adhesive and tools on hand before you start.

items.title: Dry-fit before you fasten
items.text: Set pieces in place to check fit and alignment.

items.title: Plan your finish
items.text: Priming, painting or staining? Follow the guide for your material.

blocks.title: Tips for what you ordered
blocks.source: Dynamic by purchased category (Placed Order line-item categories): one short install tip per category plus a link to that product page's installation guide. Tip content comes from the Ekena installation guides and is approved by customer service (starter tips in build_notes). Hide categories not in the order.

blocks.title: Stuck on a step?
blocks.text: Call 1-888-573-3768 with your order number and measurements, Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT or Sat 8am-12pm CT. If the guide doesn't match your situation, a professional installer is the safe call.

steps.preheader: Two minutes and a few honest words help the next person planning a project.

hero.headline: How did it turn out?
hero.subhead: Tell us, and help the next person planning a project like yours.
hero.image: Plain-text style: no hero image. If rendered designed, use a real customer install photo (with permission) of beams or a mantel in a lived-in room.

blocks.text: Your order should be with you by now, and it may already be up. Whether it's finished or still waiting in the garage, would you take two minutes to tell us how it went?

Honest reviews are how other homeowners and pros figure out whether a beam will look real overhead, whether a corbel is the right scale, or whether a shutter color suits the house. Good, bad or in between, your words help.
If it's installed, we'd love to see it. Tag us at {{ INSTAGRAM_HANDLE }} on Instagram.
And if something isn't right, call us at 1-888-573-3768 and we'll help, whether or not you leave a review.

Thanks for choosing us for your project.
The Architectural Depot team
